_comment: The mechanical sweep for this run's excerpts, per the M4 intake's sensitivity
ruling. Applied by parse.py --redact on the way into the manifest, so the record
the investigator read, the record check.py matched quotations against, and the
record in this folder are all the same swept record.
Rules are applied in order and matched case-insensitively. The URL rule runs
before the bare-handle rule so a full URL is replaced once, not twice.
